description: Search Relay's public docs (bundled, offline) for how-to, auth, errors, limits, retries, webhooks, files and pricing rules. Returns the best-matching sections: page, heading, docs path with anchor and an excerpt. For a model's input fields use get_model instead; to find a model use search_models.

limit.description: How many sections to return (1–10, default 5).

query.description: What to look for, in plain words, e.g. `idempotency key` or `file retention`.

name: search_docs
title: Search the Relay docs
